notes: Client-confirmed access (provided 2026-10-11 at the FDE's request; enforce, don't infer). Rule: A principal may read an artifact iff, on the query date, they hold a role listed in the artifact's sensitivity label. A file or message carrying several labels is open only to roles allowed by every label (the stricter wins). Mailboxes: each message has its own entry (path = mailbox, message_id); the mailbox-level entry lists only roles allowed on every message in it, so a whole-mailbox citation is safe only for those. 'people' marks personal or named-person resources (personal mailboxes, HR and finance libraries, the data room): those named people also have access regardless of role. Role holders change over time ('holders' with from/to); ask-as-person questions use the person's roles on the asked date. Mock API inbox files appear as 'api-inbox:<file id>' (the id the API serves), released on their date. Mock API records follow the same labels as their system export. Holders are as of the Day-10 snapshot (2026-10-10); later access changes arrive as acl.changed events from the mock API. Dave Brennan's access ends with his transition agreement (2026-12-29, per the Northgate README).
